# Three Reasons to Rank Daria #1
#### Daria will be a Councilmember for everyone
A Councilmember is most effective when they can build bridges, and Daria already has. She is endorsed by people and organizations who don't always agree with each other, or even with her, but who trust her values, temperament, and dedication to deliver for our community.
Daria's degree in urban planning means she understands public policy, but with her graduate degree in counseling psychology, she also knows what it takes to bring people together.
Mayor Adena Ishii endorses Daria
#### Daria advocates for the right balance on the issues
We all know that there are some incredibly divisive issues facing our community. District 1 deserves a Councilmember who will listen to everyone’s concerns and work collaboratively to offer effective policy solutions.
Mayor Adena Ishii and longtime District 1 Councilmember Linda Maio have endorsed Daria because they know she has the personal and professional skills to make good decisions under pressure. The job of a Councilmember is not just to tell everyone what they want to hear: it’s to be honest, informed, and effective. Daria has proven she is the candidate most prepared to do the job.
Former D1 Councilmember Linda Maio endorses Daria
#### Daria will defend Berkeley’s progressive values
Daria got in this race to keep Trump’s influence out of Berkeley. While hopefully the midterms bring us good news, Trump still has two more years in office. Berkeley needs to stay steadfast in defending our civil liberties and protecting our immigrant and marginalized communities.
Our policies need to reflect our values. We need to get rid of mass surveillance in Berkeley, backstop service cuts from the federal government, and take every possible moment to declare our solidarity with those most impacted by Trump’s inhumane policies.
